title: Effectiveness of Osteopathic Manipulative Therapy in Paediatric Patients, With High Frequency Headache.
brief_summary: The aim of this study is to evaluate the effectiveness of osteopathic manipulative therapy, in supporting prophylactic medications in paediatric patients, with high frequency headache.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of primary high-frequency headache attacks.
* No reduction or inconsistent reduction of attacks after two months of prophylactic treatment.

Exclusion Criteria:

Secondary headache.
